candidates.name: Caboolture West
highlights: ~30,000 homes over ~40 years
~70,000 future residents
4 state primary schools + 2 state high schools in first structure-plan area
Neighbourhood hubs, local centre, parks and active transport
candidates.risk: Large supply pipeline may suppress scarcity; transport delivery timing matters.

candidates.name: Appin (Part) Precinct
highlights: Up to 12,900 homes
Local centres with shops and services
Schools and emergency services planned in later stages
Early-stage infrastructure funding committed
Part of Greater Macarthur's much larger 40,000-home greenfield program
candidates.risk: Road/wastewater capacity and environmental constraints are material sequencing risks.

candidates.name: Greater Macarthur Growth Area
highlights: 18,000 urban-renewal homes + up to 40,000 greenfield homes
Up to 40,000 local jobs
Appin, North Appin and Gilead land-release precincts
Transport, centres, parks and services planned at regional scale
candidates.risk: Too broad to buy blindly; individual precinct timing and entry price matter much more than the headline growth number.

candidates.name: Western Sydney Aerotropolis / Bradfield
highlights: Bradfield City Centre capacity for ~10,000 homes and ~20,000 jobs
More than 100,000 jobs planned across the Aerotropolis
Western Sydney Airport + Metro + M12 and road upgrades
High-skill employment focus
candidates.risk: Land values may already capitalise substantial infrastructure expectations; aircraft noise limits residential locations.

candidates.name: Ballarat North future greenfield area
highlights: Estimated capacity ~6,000 homes
~600 jobs capacity
Listed in Victoria's forward greenfield planning program
Very early stage can create optionality if infrastructure commitments strengthen
candidates.risk: Early planning status means infrastructure, timing and final developable capacity remain less certain.
